contributor to MP (1890-2), local historian

According to Devon and Cornwall Notes and Queries (1941) ‘The death of Miss Beatrix Feodore Clara Augusta Grace ' Cresswell took place at Exeter on the 16th February, 1940, in her seventy-ninth year.’ Her father, the Rev. Richard Cresswell, was a clergyman without cure of souls in the 1881 census; they lived at Teignmouth.
